summary:
Walkthrough of the Multi-Core Instability Fix.
Resolved an `IndexError` caused by incorrect loop bounds in the multi-core batch distributor and fixed an `AssertionError` in round-by-round validation. The validation failure was traced to the VLIW packer reordering instructions across Round boundaries, which was resolved by implementing a `barrier()` mechanism to ensure strict ordering around `pause` instructions. Final performance achieved 385 cycles (approx. 383x speedup).
